f.title: Notify the EU QPPV and the national PV reference person (LPPV) to the Luxembourg authorities
f.statement: Under Article 45-3 of the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 15 December 1992 (as amended on 10 September 2012), the MAH communicates to the Directorate of Health and to the Agency the name and contact details of the qualified person and of the national pharmacovigilance reference person, who is attached to the QPPV. The notification form is available on sante.lu and, once completed, must be sent by e-mail to the Luxembourg pharmacovigilance mailbox.
f.clause: Q1. Comment notifier l'EU QPPV et la LPPV au Luxembourg ?
f.legal_basis: Règlement grand-ducal du 15 décembre 1992, art. 45-3 (as amended by RGD of 10 September 2012)

rows.quote: le titulaire de l'autorisation de mise sur le marché (AMM) communique à la Direction de la Santé et à l'Agence le nom et les coordonnées de la personne qualifiée, ainsi que de la personne de référence pour la pharmacovigilance au niveau national, rattachée à la personne qualifiée responsable des activités de pharmacovigilance. Le formulaire de notification est disponible sur le site sante.lu
rows.location: Q1. Comment notifier l'EU QPPV et la LPPV au Luxembourg ?
rows.review_note: Review: legal duty restated by the guidance (present indicative in the cited regulation = Mandatory). E-mail address omitted from the quote by design. Double-check: quote proves addressees and content; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: the marketing authorisation holder (MAH) communicates to the Directorate of Health and to the Agency the name and contact details of the qualified person, as well as of the reference person for pharmacovigilance at national level, attached to the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance activities. The notification form is available on the sante.lu website

f.statement: Once completed, the notification form must be sent by e-mail to the Luxembourg Ministry of Health pharmacovigilance mailbox (address given in the source).

f.title: LPPV must report to the EU QPPV, reside and work in the EU, and have sufficient PV experience
f.statement: The local contact person (LPPV) reports to the EU QPPV, must reside and carry out his or her activities in the European Union, and must demonstrate sufficient experience in all aspects of pharmacovigilance to fulfil the responsibilities and tasks of the post.
f.clause: Q2. Quels sont les requis pour la personne de contact (LPPV) au Luxembourg ?

rows.quote: Il/Elle rend compte à la personne qualifiée européenne responsable de la pharmacovigilance (EU-QPPV). • Il/Elle doit résider et exercer ses activités dans l'Union européenne.
rows.location: Q2. Quels sont les requis pour la personne de contact (LPPV) au Luxembourg ?
rows.review_note: Review: experience requirement taken from the next bullet ('doit justifier d'une expérience suffisante sur tous les aspects de la pharmacovigilance'); quote covers reporting line and residence. Double-check: statement faithful to Q2 bullets 1, 2 and 4; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: He/She reports to the European qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance (EU-QPPV). • He/She must reside and carry out his/her activities in the European Union.

f.title: LPPV must be reachable 24/7 by authorities, healthcare professionals and the public
f.statement: The LPPV must be reachable 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, by the authorities, healthcare professionals and the public alike.
f.clause: Q6. La LPPV doit-elle être joignable 24h sur 24 et 7j sur 7 ?

rows.quote: La personne de contact locale doit être joignable 24h/24, aussi bien vis-à-vis des autorités, des professionnels de la santé que du public.
rows.location: Q6. La LPPV doit-elle être joignable 24h sur 24 et 7j sur 7 ?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The local contact person must be reachable 24 hours a day, vis-à-vis the authorities, healthcare professionals and the public alike.

f.title: Call forwarding or answering machine allowed only if the LPPV is directly reachable; check and document
f.statement: Call forwarding, a call centre or an answering machine are acceptable provided the LPPV (or a replacement) is directly reachable through them. The answering machine must therefore be checked regularly outside working hours, and this must be documented.
f.clause: Q6. La LPPV doit-elle être joignable 24h sur 24 et 7j sur 7 ?
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: Ces dispositifs sont acceptables à condition que la personne de contact locale (ou son remplaçant) soit joignable directement via ces moyens. Le répondeur automatique doit donc être vérifié régulièrement en dehors des heures de service, et cela doit être documenté.
rows.location: Q6. La LPPV doit-elle être joignable 24h sur 24 et 7j sur 7 ?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: These arrangements are acceptable provided that the local contact person (or his/her replacement) can be reached directly through these means. The answering machine must therefore be checked regularly outside working hours, and this must be documented.

f.title: LPPV must have the language skills to communicate nationally (English and/or FR, DE or LB strongly recommended)
f.statement: The LPPV must have the language skills needed to communicate at national level with the various stakeholders; English and/or one of the official national languages (French, German, Luxembourgish) are strongly recommended.
f.clause: Q2. Quels sont les requis pour la personne de contact (LPPV) au Luxembourg ?

rows.quote: Il/Elle doit posséder les connaissances linguistiques nécessaires pour communiquer au niveau national avec les différentes parties prenantes : l'anglais et/ou l'une des langues nationales officielles (français, allemand, luxembourgeois) sont fortement recommandés.
rows.location: Q2. Quels sont les requis pour la personne de contact (LPPV) au Luxembourg ?
rows.review_note: Review: headline duty 'doit posséder' = Mandatory; the specific languages are 'fortement recommandés' (Recommended) and stated as such. Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: He/She must have the language skills necessary to communicate at national level with the various stakeholders: English and/or one of the official national languages (French, German, Luxembourgish) are strongly recommended.

f.title: Declare the LPPV as soon as the MA is granted, including centralised authorisations
f.statement: Declaration of the LPPV is required as soon as the marketing authorisation is obtained, including for products authorised through the centralised procedure, in which Luxembourg is automatically included.
f.clause: Q3. A quel moment doit se faire la notification ?
f.applicability: All MAs valid in Luxembourg, including centrally authorised products

f.title: Have and notify an LPPV for every valid Luxembourg MA, marketed or not
f.statement: Pharmacovigilance requirements apply to every valid MA whether or not the product is marketed in Luxembourg. Every MAH in Luxembourg must have a local pharmacovigilance contact person and notify that person following the procedure in Q1.
f.clause: Q4. Le titulaire d'AMM doit-il déclarer une LPPV si les médicaments ne sont pas commercialisés au Luxembourg ?
f.applicability: Products authorised in Luxembourg, marketed or not

f.title: Keep an LPPV for as long as the MA is valid, even after market withdrawal
f.statement: The MAH must have an LPPV for as long as the marketing authorisation is valid, including after the product is withdrawn from the Luxembourg market.
f.clause: Q5. La LPPV est-elle toujours requise lorsque le médicament est retiré du marché luxembourgeois ?

rows.deadline: For the whole validity of the MA
rows.quote: Le titulaire d'AMM doit disposer d'une LPPV tant que l'autorisation de mise sur le marché est valide.
rows.location: Q5. La LPPV est-elle toujours requise lorsque le médicament est retiré du marché luxembourgeois ?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The MAH must have an LPPV as long as the marketing authorisation is valid.

f.title: Ensure a qualified person responsible for PV is permanently and continuously available
f.statement: Appointing a deputy LPPV is not mandatory; nevertheless the MAH must permanently and continuously have at its disposal an appropriately qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance.
f.clause: Q7. Est-il nécessaire de nommer un « deputy LPPV » ?
f.exceptions: A deputy LPPV is not mandatory.

rows.quote: La nomination d'un « deputy LPPV » n'est pas obligatoire. Néanmoins le titulaire d'AMM doit avoir de façon permanente et continue à sa disposition une personne possédant les qualifications appropriées, responsable pour la pharmacovigilance.
rows.location: Q7. Est-il nécessaire de nommer un « deputy LPPV » ?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Appointing a 'deputy LPPV' is not mandatory. Nevertheless the MAH must have permanently and continuously at its disposal a person with the appropriate qualifications, responsible for pharmacovigilance.

f.title: May nominate a deputy LPPV via the notification form
f.statement: If it wishes, the MAH may nominate a deputy LPPV in addition to the LPPV, using the notification form available on sante.lu.
f.clause: Q7. Est-il nécessaire de nommer un « deputy LPPV » ?

rows.quote: Si le titulaire le souhaite, il peut nommer un « deputy LPPV » en plus de la LPPV, via le formulaire de notification

f.title: Communicate any LPPV change or deregistration as quickly as possible via the form
f.statement: Any change (replacement or deregistration) of the LPPV must be communicated as quickly as possible, also via the notification form and following the procedure in Q1.
f.clause: Q8. Est-il nécessaire de procéder à la radiation de la LPPV ?

rows.quote: Toute modification (changement/radiation) de la personne de contact (LPPV) doit être communiquée le plus rapidement. Cette communication se fait également via le formulaire et selon la procédure décrite à la question 1.
rows.location: Q8. Est-il nécessaire de procéder à la radiation de la LPPV ?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Any modification (change/deregistration) of the contact person (LPPV) must be communicated as quickly as possible. This communication is also made via the form and according to the procedure described in question 1.

f.title: Each MAH submits its own LPPV notification form, even within a group sharing one PV system
f.statement: Each marketing authorisation holder must submit an LPPV notification form, regardless of whether it uses the same pharmacovigilance system or belongs to the same parent company as other MAHs.
f.clause: Q9. Un seul formulaire pour plusieurs titulaires de la même société mère ?

rows.quote: Chaque titulaire d'autorisation de mise sur le marché doit transmettre un formulaire de notification de la LPPV, indépendamment du fait qu'il utilise le même système de pharmacovigilance ou appartienne à la même société mère.
rows.location: Q9. Un seul formulaire pour plusieurs titulaires de la même société mère ?
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Each marketing authorisation holder must submit an LPPV notification form, irrespective of whether it uses the same pharmacovigilance system or belongs to the same parent company.

f.statement: Updating the notification form is not mandatory when the change concerns only the EU QPPV, but it is strongly recommended.

f.title: Inform the Luxembourg PV mailbox promptly of any Article 57 database change
f.statement: The Luxembourg authority asks MAHs to inform it as soon as possible, by e-mail to the pharmacovigilance mailbox, of any change made in the Article 57 database.

f.title: Separate LPPVs may be designated per PSMF; one person may cover several PSMFs
f.statement: Where the MAH has several PSMFs, a different local contact person may be designated for each PSMF. The same person may also act as LPPV for different PSMFs, provided he or she can perform the tasks and responsibilities properly.

rows.quote: Dans le cas où il y a plusieurs PSMF pour le même titulaire d'AMM, une personne de contact locale différente peut être désignée pour chaque PSMF. Il est également possible qu'une même personne agisse comme personne de contact (LPPV) pour différents PSMF, à condition que celle-ci puisse effectuer ses tâches/exercer ses responsabilités de manière correcte.

It is also possible for the same person to act as contact person (LPPV) for different PSMFs, provided that he/she can carry out his/her tasks/exercise his/her responsibilities properly.

f.title: Designate only one LPPV per PSMF, whatever the number of distributors
f.statement: If the products handled by different distributors fall under the same PSMF, only one local contact person may be designated; there is always a single local contact person per PSMF.
f.clause: Q12. Une LPPV différente pour chaque distributeur ?
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Non, si les médicaments chez les différents distributeurs relèvent du même PSMF, une seule personne de contact locale doit être désignée. Il y a toujours une seule personne de contact locale par PSMF.

rows.quote_en: No, if the medicinal products at the different distributors fall under the same PSMF, only one local contact person must be designated. There is always only one local contact person per PSMF.
